title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at $64,664 with only a 0.1% gain as fear grips the market at a 29 reading. US morning action stayed flat with no breakout momentum.

On-chain, the mempool sits clogged at 88,556 transactions while the fastest fee lingers at just 3 sat/vB, showing backlog without urgent demand. Hashrate steadies near 794 EH/s as the chain pushes past block 961,470.

No fresh catalysts emerged in the session.
